text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Did you end up enjoying that novel?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It was so good! There was so much
exciting magic
used by all these cool
witches!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The coolest witch out of everyone was
Kashiwagi!
She reminded me of my
grandma.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I know! She really is a wonderful witch!
The
bubbling compassion behind her
witty demeanor,
the way she watches
over the protagonist from a
distance...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And when the main character is in real
trouble,
she gallantly appears and saves
the day with her
powerful spells! She's
depicted as completely
nonchalant—I
love it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! That's why I thought she's so
cool!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I also can't say enough about Witch
Agito! Not
matter how misunderstood
she was, she had the
inner strength to
stay true to herself!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The fateful rival she encountered in the
course of
walking her own path! The
fierce battle that
ensued and her classic
line—"Destiny is but a
chew toy for a
witch!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I-I'm so sorry. I've been jabbering on
this
whole time...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I love when you talk all you want about
the books
you love! You can't just cut
yourself off in the
middle of a flow like
that! It's lame!
